tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get details of an event, including per-time-option vote tallies and who voted. Pass share_token to also get your own vote per option.

tools.name: add_time_option
tools.description: Add a time option to an event

tools.name: vote_time_option
tools.description: Vote yes/no/maybe on a proposed meeting time. Organizers use owner_token; other voters use share_token.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of event availability with per-time-option breakdown and your own votes. Pass share_token for per-option your_response.

tools.name: add_participant
tools.description: Add a participant to an existing event
